headline: Meta brings Muse to Singapore
dek: The AI agent arrives with local shopping, dining and travel partners, per Meta.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: Muse's second market
body: Meta brought Muse, its personal AI agent, to Singapore, per a company announcement.
The agent links to Gmail, Google Calendar and Instagram to handle email and scheduling, Meta says.

points.t: Shopee and Lazada, to compare prices (Meta).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: Security and sign-off
body: Muse runs on a cloud virtual machine that keeps passwords and payment data away from the agent, per Meta.
For sensitive steps like sending email or buying, the agent checks with the person first, Meta says.

items.t: They roll out step by step, Meta says.
Access through AI glasses has no date yet (Meta).
Meta has not said if Muse reaches more countries.

caption.hook: Meta brought Muse, its personal AI agent, to Singapore, with local shopping and travel partners.
body: Per Meta, the agent links to Gmail, Google Calendar and Instagram, plus services like Shopee, Grab, Agoda and Singapore Airlines. It can compare prices, line up food orders and handle travel bookings.

The company says Muse runs on a cloud virtual machine that keeps passwords and payment data away from the agent, and it checks with the person before sending an email or buying. Connectors roll out step by step, and Meta has not said whether Muse reaches other markets.
